an3.80:1.1: 81 athakho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an3.80:1.2: sammukhā metaṃ bhante bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ
an3.80:1.3: bhagavato ānanda sikhissa abhibhū nāma sāvako brahmaloke ṭhito sahassīlokadhātuṃ sarena viññāpesīti
an3.80:1.4: bhagavā pana bhante arahaṃ sammāsambuddho kīvatakaṃ pahoti sarena viññāpetunti.
an3.80:2.1: dutiyampi kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an3.80:2.2: sammukhā metaṃ bhante bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ
an3.80:2.3: bhagavato ānanda sikhissa abhibhū nāma sāvako brahmaloke ṭhito sahassīlokadhātuṃ sarena viññāpesīti
an3.80:2.4: bhagavā pana bhante arahaṃ sammāsambuddho kīvatakaṃ pahoti sarena viññāpetunti.
an3.80:3.1: tatiyampi kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an3.80:3.2: sammukhā metaṃ bhante bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ
an3.80:3.3: bhagavato ānanda sikhissa abhibhū nāma sāvako brahmaloke ṭhito sahassīlokadhātuṃ sarena viññāpesīti
an3.80:3.4: bhagavā pana bhante arahaṃ sammāsambuddho kīvatakaṃ pahoti sarena viññāpetunti.
an3.80:3.5: sutā te ānanda sahassī cūḷanikā lokadhātūti.
an3.80:3.6: etassa bhagavā kālo etassa sugata kālo
an3.80:3.7: yaṃ bhagavā bhāseyya bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantīti.
an3.80:3.9: evaṃ bhanteti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paccassosi.
an3.80:4.1: yāvatānanda candimasuriyā pariharanti disā bhanti virocanā tāva sahassadhā loko
an3.80:4.2: tasmiṃ sahassaṃ candānaṃ sahassaṃ suriyānaṃ sahassaṃ sinerupabbatarājānaṃ sahassaṃ jambūdīpānaṃ sahassaṃ aparagoyānaṃ sahassaṃ uttarakurūnaṃ sahassaṃ pubbavidehānaṃ cattāri mahāsamuddasahassāni cattāri mahārājasahassāni sahassaṃ cātummahārājikānaṃ sahassaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ sahassaṃ yāmānaṃ sahassaṃ tusitānaṃ sahassaṃ nimmānaratīnaṃ sahassaṃ paranimmitavasavattīnaṃ sahassaṃ brahmalokānaṃ
an3.80:5.1: yāvatānanda sahassī cūḷanikā lokadhātu tāva sahassadhā loko
an3.80:6.1: yāvatānanda dvisahassī majjhimikā lokadhātu tāva sahassadhā loko
an3.80:7.1: ākaṅkhamāno ānanda tathāgato tisahassiṃ mahāsahassiṃ lokadhātuṃ sarena viññāpeyya yāvatā vā pana ākaṅkheyyāti.
an3.80:8.1: yathākathaṃ pana bhante bhagavā tisahassiṃ mahāsahassiṃ lokadhātuṃ sarena viññāpeyya yāvatā vā pana ākaṅkheyyāti.
an3.80:8.2: idhānanda tathāgato tisahassiṃ mahāsahassiṃ lokadhātuṃ obhāsena phareyya
an3.80:8.3: yadā te sattā taṃ ālokaṃ sañjāneyyuṃ atha tathāgato ghosaṃ kareyya saddamanussāveyya
an3.80:8.4: evaṃ kho ānanda tathāgato tisahassiṃ mahāsahassiṃ lokadhātuṃ sarena viññāpeyya yāvatā vā pana ākaṅkheyyāti.
an3.80:9.2: lābhā vata me suladdhaṃ vata me
an3.80:9.4: evaṃ vutte āyasmā udāyi āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca
an3.80:9.5: kiṃ tuyhettha āvuso ānanda yadi te satthā evaṃmahiddhiko evaṃmahānubhāvoti.
an3.80:9.6: evaṃ vutte bhagavā āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ etadavoca
an3.80:9.8: udāyi ānando avītarāgo kālaṃ kareyya tena cittappasādena sattakkhattuṃ devesu devarajjaṃ kāreyya sattakkhattuṃ imasmiṃyeva jambūdīpe mahārajjaṃ kāreyya
an3.80:9.9: apica udāyi ānando diṭṭheva dhamme parinibbāyissatīti.
